Such a big reputed gym no functional equipment like big truck tire, Sledgehammer, CrossFit standalone rig, battle rope. Having only cardio and weight machines is very common in every gym even in basic old gyms around . I was in Slimwell gym earlier , even they had all above mentioned stuff at just 10k year. This gym charges 20k-25k for just basic gym equipments. Which also I was ready to pay but where is the uniqueness and no CrossFit area. This was highly upsetting & disappointing. Big NO for now. Atleast deliver as per your gym rates. This gym looks 5/5 , but total waste and incomplete. It’s 2/5 now. All that glitters is not gold. You’ll have degraded your own gym standards. Upgrade smartly before it’s too late. Hope to join you’ll soon after upgradation.
